note: Reproduced adversarial payload: the digest changed, so a fresh idempotency_key was minted embedding the new digest suffix. This is the exact double-send the identity ruling exists to prevent: digest A publishes, the basket changes to digest B, a re-authorization mints a NEW key, and the same issue date publishes twice.
violates: invariant: idempotency_key must be derived from the publication identity alone, never the content digest
